mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_version (doc_id, version_no, storage_key, size, sha256, source, created_by) VALUES (#{docId}, #{versionNo}, #{storageKey}, #{size}, #{sha256}, #{source}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT version_id, doc_id, version_no, storage_key, size, sha256, source, created_by, created_at FROM tb_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
